mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising for 3 months), increased cost of capital reduces equity valuations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day return during monetary tightening cycles is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction term (PAYEMS * UNRATE) has a Rank IC below 0.03 with 20-day returns over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 700,000 units signals weak consumer demand and reduced construction activity, depressing economic growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances where HOUST < 700.0.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between INDPRO and 60-day S&P 500 returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 > 13500 billion), economic overheating increases inflationary pressures and prompts central bank tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day return during periods when GDPC1 > 13500.0 is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained annualized CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations, prompting central bank monetary tightening and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized inflation > 2.5%.
